cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Social Media Content Creator position at your company. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in content creation, SEO, and web design, I have developed the skills necessary to create engaging social media content and manage multiple client accounts effectively.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I write keyword-targeted blog content and manage on-page SEO for client websites. This experience has honed my copywriting skills and taught me how to craft content that resonates with audiences and drives engagement. I am also responsible for building and maintaining client websites in WordPress, which has given me a solid understanding of content management systems and the importance of visual consistency.

One of my proudest achievements is my project mirook.com, where I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion. I integrated social media channels (Instagram and Facebook) and implemented structured data to improve search visibility. This project demonstrates my ability to manage social media accounts, collaborate on visuals, and think creatively to grow brand presence.

I am proficient in major social platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn, and I have experience using analytics tools like Google Analytics and Search Console to monitor engagement metrics and report on performance. I am also comfortable with basic photo and video editing using Canva and AI-assisted tools.

Your offer of a young and dynamic team, learning opportunities, and growth potential aligns perfectly with my career goals. I am eager to bring my creativity, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple accounts to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your clients' success.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
